svg.title: Buzano–Nguyen–Schulz: surface and interior
svg.desc: Original genus-three topology schematic inspired by Figures 3 and 4. A rounded cap and a central sheet connect through alternating openings to one outer sheet. The right view removes the front half to expose the interior. Not a computed self-shrinker.

g.text: A surface with handles, and a sheet through its center
One connected surface, with one outer sheet
Front half removed: central sheet exposed
Gold and blue show the two sides of the same surface.
Outer rim and cut edges are display boundaries; the surface continues to infinity.
SCHEMATIC · not an exact formula or a numerical solution of the shrinker equation
One end is proved for sufficiently large genus; Figures 3–4 supply numerical evidence at low genus.
